faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani) for an ANRF sponsored research project at their Pilani campus.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names available in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the positions of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Associate-1 under a single recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech or M.Tech degree in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering with a first-class or equivalent grade from a reputed university or institute.

faq.question: Q5. Is GATE or NET qualification mandatory?
faq.answer: GATE or UGC/CSIR-NET qualification is required for candidates applying specifically for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 30 years, with age relaxation applicable as per standard government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 37,000/- plus 10% HRA per month for JRF (with NET/GATE), and Rs. 30,000/- plus 10% HRA per month for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 8 October 2026. Make sure to send all required documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply by emailing their detailed CV, cover letter, referee contact details, and relevant scorecards to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit, academic credentials, experience, followed by an online interview.
